name: adk-harness
description: Govern Google Workspace and coding-agent harness actions through a policy-gated MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Policy-gated Google Workspace and agent tools
interface.longDescription: ADK Harness exposes Google Workspace and coding-agent harness operations through an MCP server with explicit policy decisions. Reads can run, reversible writes can be held for approval, and irreversible actions remain refused.
defaultPrompt: What can ADK Harness do in this workspace?
List my upcoming calendar events through the policy gate.
Draft a Gmail message without sending it.
